purpose: What every locked production package declares about its own licence, so the bill of materials can state terms for all of them instead of only the ones package-lock.json happens to record a `license` field for. Never hand-edited: regenerate with `npm run vendor:npm-licenses`.
evidence_basis: Declared in the package.json inside the registry tarball that package-lock.json pins, after the tarball bytes were verified against the locked integrity digest.
